style: Refine every catalog object toward warm, softly lit cartoon art, consistent with the selected plant reference. Preserve identity, function and original palette family. Keep registered camera, dimensions, roots, sockets, ports, footprints and animation timing. No preferred horizontal light direction for rotatable world sprites; no directional ground shadows. Real 3D render output, editable Blender sources. The source 2D effects remain explicitly identified as 2D. Each object receives fresh independent editor/judge agents. Publish object-by-object to the same PR preview; integrate approved sprites into Godot after catalog review checks. Follow-on design exploration: improve the modeling itself, including forms, proportions, structure, crafted details and decorations. Original part counts and awkward geometry are not constraints. The editor may rebuild native geometry to achieve the better design; the judge should reward useful improvements. Preserve the locked registration, gameplay contact/clearance, animation and modular continuity contract. See modeling-policy.json version2.

source.scene: Inspect the named asset collection; do not use an unrelated active scene

target.interpretation: Reward useful native modeling and decoration inspired by the target. Do not reject a change solely because it differs from the source. Reject target drift only when it harms the chosen style, readability, role or locked technical contract. Original part counts and weak shapes are not automatically constraints.

qualityCriteria.definitionOfGood: A calm continuous aqua/turquoise water floor with soft connected caustic volume, restrained pale warm highlights, purposeful readable detail and a clean one-second scrolling loop across exact tile borders.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: The floor stays flat and fully covers one registered cell. Its water has softly modeled optical depth from broad rounded caustic regions and gentle surface variation; no slab, rocks or raised silhouette is required. Improve the weak two-band construction when useful.
priorityOutcomes.review: Compare fixed target, original and native captures at256,128 and phone filtered size. Shape-volume score concerns water-surface depth/readability rather than adding physical height.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Preserve the turquoise/aqua palette family, separating a rich calm water field, softly lighter cyan regions and restrained pale warm-green highlights. The surface should remain water beneath scene objects, with no dark rectangular frame, muddy merged regions, harsh white knots or broad cyan clipping.
priorityOutcomes.review: Inspect light/gray/dark composites and floor with frozen submarine/rock context; do not recolor facings separately.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Broad soft reflections reveal connected flowing caustic structure, without a preferred horizontal light direction or ground-cast shadow. Bright intersections taper gently into the surface instead of becoming isolated white dots.
priorityOutcomes.review: All four native cardinal rotations under one shared lighting/material setup. The plant reference guides warmth and material clarity, not literal green/orange colors.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: Purposeful, legible caustic branches and rounded interior gradients replace the broad empty field and flat dark ribbons. Fine variation may support the material but should not become grain, aliasing or clutter at logical/phone size.
priorityOutcomes.review: Reward native design improvements; do not lock old part count, UV absence, flat colors, borders, waveform topology or downward wave normals.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A repeated3×3 patch reads as one continuous underwater surface. Neither X/depth tile borders nor four-tile corners reveal dark grids, empty seams, mismatched pattern branches, raised rims, exposure changes or tile-local vignettes. Full opaque coverage must come from the native registered surface.
priorityOutcomes.review: Both unchanged-pitch native3×3 assembly and independently assembled exported3×3 sprites, all4 facings/all12 unique phases, logical and real phone filtering. A disconnected tile or target border cannot prove continuity.

priorityOutcomes.outcome: A restrained calm one-second water loop remains visibly animated and periodic at12fps. Every shared edge stays connected through all12 phases and closure; no phase-locked tile drift, sparkle, popping or seam flicker appears under fractional pan/root sampling. No dead black patch, clipping, broken corner, exposed join or unwanted halo is accepted.
priorityOutcomes.review: Use side-by-side frame strips plus actual looping playback and fractional samples; compare wrap11→0 to ordinary steps. At least6 distinct visible frames are required by catalog; source has12. No new gameplay or deferred2D effects are added.
